    How This RFP Flow Works

    From drawings to a conversation

    This demo's proposed intake flow, designed for how architects, designers, and GCs scope metalwork — documents first, conversation second.

    STEP 01

    You submit the brief

    Choose a project type, describe the scope, and list your drawings, specs, or takeoff. One form builds the whole brief.

    STEP 02

    One email carries it

    The brief opens in your own email app, addressed to info@arcmet.com — you attach the listed files and send. Nothing is uploaded to this page.

    STEP 03

    The scope is reviewable

    Because the brief is structured — type, project, reference, scope, attachments — it can be reviewed against the drawings instead of reconstructed from a phone call.

    STEP 04

    Talk it through

    Follow up by phone at 732-352-0763 or by reply — the brief you sent is the shared starting point for the conversation.
